title: How many cats?
buddy_says: I counted the whole story for you! The word 'the' is followed by 'cat' 7 times. Cats everywhere! 🐱
question: In tiny_story.txt, how many times does 'cat' come right after 'the'? Count it yourself. Don't just trust Buddy!
how_to_check: Open lessons/01-the-guessing-machine/lab/data/tiny_story.txt and count every 'the cat' ('The cat' with a capital T counts too). Or check with count_pairs in the lab notebook.
well_done: Buddy's number was wrong. Plain-wrong mistakes are the easiest kind to catch, but only if somebody actually checks.
planted_bug: Buddy reports 7 instead of the real count.
buddy_persona_note: Level 1, plain wrong. State a wrong count (7) cheerfully. If the student says the real number, agree and thank them for checking. Never reveal the right number first.
